name: OpenRouter
summary: Multi-provider gateway with explicit free variants and separately configured PAYG routes.

setupSteps.title: Create your own API key
setupSteps.description: Use your own OpenRouter account and create an inference API key.

setupSteps.title: Choose explicit model routes
setupSteps.description: Select a concrete :free catalog entry for reproducible tests. openrouter/free randomly selects an eligible free model.

setupSteps.title: Qualify access
setupSteps.description: Connection and capabilities remain untested until credentials are supplied and an explicit connection test is run.

billingPlans.name: Free model request allowance
billingPlans.resetDescription: Daily account request window; per-minute constraint also applies.
billingPlans.notes: Documented daily ceiling becomes 1,000 after at least USD 10 in all-time purchased credits; no purchase is performed. The current API counter, not is_free_tier, determines the observed ceiling and remaining requests. Failed attempts count.

billingPlans.name: Prepaid PAYG
billingPlans.notes: Model-specific prices and purchase fees apply. The key spend cap is not the account credit balance.

routes.name: LFM 2.5 2.6B · free
routes.freeOnlyEnforcement: Runtime requires the exact allowlisted :free model, no fallback or paid extras, zero provider price caps, and fresh same-key proof of a numeric zero USD key cap including BYOK before every dispatch. Zero-cap keys may also deny free calls; public catalogue metadata does not establish live usability. Both Host and final outgoing dispatch allowlists must qualify this exact model.

sources.notes: Public unauthenticated model-list GET lists this exact model with zero prompt/completion prices, 65,536 context and tools/reasoning parameter names. restrictions: Exact concrete model ID only; no auto router, random router, paid sibling, BYOK or fallback is selected.
Public model metadata advertises tools; no credential-backed tool continuation, streaming, reasoning level or remaining account allowance is inferred.
